core:
Create a NEW companion character concept sheet matching the reference pixel-art game avatars: rounded square heads, large expressive pixel eyes, chunky readable silhouettes, head and upper torso, crisp 16-bit pixel art with limited shading. Pale lavender tiles, offwhite gutters, navy caption bars with accurately spelled white Spanish names. Each character is original and appealing, with distinct personality and one main accessory. Skin colors varied across roles, natural features using the same stylized eyes for everyone. No logos or watermark. Not photos, not smooth vector or 3D. Keep detail simpler than reference for small game avatars.
SQUARE 3 columns x 3 rows, exactly NINE characters. Row-major order:
LA ABUELA: elderly brown woman, silver hair bun, big round black glasses, pink cardigan, small coffee cup, affectionate knowing smile; visual continuity with original game's grandma.
EL PORTU: Portuguese-Venezuelan middle-aged baker, short black hair, thick black moustache, cream shirt, green apron, a loaf of bread at shoulder, proud friendly expression.
EL CHINO: Chinese-Venezuelan young adult man, natural black side-part hair, rectangular modern glasses, teal polo shirt, game controller, competitive playful eyebrow. Normal friendly features; no ethnic caricature, no costume.
EL LLAVE: dark brown young adult man, close fade haircut, purple sports jacket, silver chain, fist-bump toward viewer, loyal confident grin. Streetwear best friend, no criminal cues, not a locksmith.
EL CARIBEÑO SIFRINO: tan young adult man with wavy shoulder-length dark hair, thin moustache, expensive-looking amber sunglasses, open cream tropical linen shirt, shell necklace, small guitar neck. Relaxed Caribbean indie-band aesthetic evocative of Rawayana's tropical mood, not a portrait of a real musician. Caption may wrap on two lines.
EL CARAJITO: clearly a school-age boy, square head but smaller torso, backward orange cap, missing front baby tooth, blue t-shirt, handheld game console, mischievous wide grin. Child-appropriate.
LA SIFRINA: retain reference honey-brown hair and pink polo, sunglasses on head, pearl earrings, iced coffee, raised competitive eyebrow.
EL MARACUCHO: retain reference broad moustache, tropical yellow shirt, sunglasses on head, laughing expression; now small furro drum instead of fan to absorb gaitero identity. There is NO separate gaitero character.
EL LLANERO: retain reference dark-brown skin, straw hat, cream shirt, red neckerchief, cuatro neck, relaxed confident smile.
